mapper.select: SELECT pr.*,u.display_name engineer_name,ro.order_no FROM part_request pr JOIN system_user u ON u.user_id=pr.engineer_id JOIN repair_order ro ON ro.order_id=pr.order_id ORDER BY CASE pr.status WHEN 'PENDING' THEN 0 WHEN 'APPROVED' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,pr.created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM part_request WHERE part_request_id=#{requestId} AND status='PENDING'
SELECT * FROM part_request WHERE part_request_id=#{requestId} AND status='APPROVED'
SELECT * FROM part_request_item WHERE part_request_id=#{requestId} ORDER BY item_id
mapper.update: UPDATE part_request SET status='ISSUED' WHERE part_request_id=#{requestId}
UPDATE part_request SET status='COMPLETED' WHERE part_request_id=#{requestId} AND status='ISSUED'
